c: Open each incident and go to Related Records.
say: Link from the incident side. Open each incident and go to related records.

c: Set Problem. The problem form doesn't list its incidents on pdi2.
say: Set the problem field. On pdi2 the problem form doesn't list its incidents.

c: If only the problem can fix it, set On Hold with reason Awaiting Problem. Only linked, it stays with its team.
say: If only the problem can fix it, put the incident on hold, awaiting problem. An incident that is only linked stays with its team.

c: When the problem is fixed, waiting incidents are resolved for you.
say: When the problem is fixed, the incidents waiting for it are resolved for you.

c: Attaching the problem's known error article to an incident links it too.
say: A shortcut: attaching the problem's known error article to an incident links it to the problem.
